As a Senior Creative Engineer , you are a seasoned professional in digital design and creative production at scale. You will work with an amazing team of creatives to ensure artwork is designed and adapted according to our client’s brand guidelines while maintaining the highest quality standards. You will take design briefs and key art from the account and creative team, ensuring conceptual creative ideas are translated into scalable digital assets ready for market.
You are an ideal candidate if you come from an advertising agency or production design studio and have worked across a variety of creative projects including digital campaigns, marketing collateral, motion graphics, brand work, advertising, and high-volume production.

You enjoy building scalable design systems, creating templates, mentoring others, and continuously improving creative workflows. You are adaptable, eager to learn new technologies and automation tools, and thrive in fast-paced environments.

Collaborate with the Creative Team to bring their ideas to life while ensuring best practices and brand standards remain top of mind.
Design and adapt key art into pixel-perfect digital assets across multiple formats, sizes, and platforms.
Create and maintain scalable templates and design systems to support high-volume creative production.
Produce high-quality motion graphics and animated assets for digital campaigns.
Bring forward ideas to improve the team’s systems, templates, automation, and creative production workflows.
Work with internal teams, Account, and Creative to ensure continuity of delivery of final files within agreed timeframes and to high standards.
Become fully ingrained in the brand’s design systems and act as a gatekeeper of brand guidelines.
Mentor junior and mid-level Creative Engineers, supporting their technical and production design development while fostering collaboration and team growth.
Understand technical limitations across digital platforms and recommend creative solutions that maximize design quality and platform performance.
Build clean, organized creative files that support scalable production and future campaign adaptations.
Create detailed documentation and template guides to clearly communicate production workflows and design systems.
Stay up to date on digital production best practices, motion design trends, creative technologies, and automation tools.
Demonstrate adaptability and a continuous learning mindset while embracing new tools and evolving production processes.

3–5 years of experience working as a Production Designer, Designer, Motion Designer, or Creative Engineer in an advertising agency, production studio, or design environment.
Extensive experience working within high-volume, high-scale creative production workflows.
Strong experience building and maintaining design systems, templates, and scalable creative assets.
Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including After Effects for motion design.
Strong motion design and animation skills.
Advanced proficiency in Figma (Sketch experience is a plus).
Experience with, or willingness to learn, creative automation platforms such as Celtra or Orca Plus .
Experience building and editing Keynote and PowerPoint presentations.
A collaborative mindset with the ability to mentor and develop junior team members.
Pixel-perfect attention to detail with a strong commitment to quality assurance.
Expertise in layout production, image optimization, static and animated digital advertising, email production, and visual guidelines.
General understanding of HTML5.
Strong problem-solving skills, adaptability, and the ability to quickly learn new tools and technologies.
Maternity and parental leave extra days

Vacation, compassionate leave, sick days, and flex days
Access to online services for families and new parents
Diversity and Inclusion Board with 12 affinity groups
Internal learning and development programs
Enterprise-wide employee discounts

About the job The Creative Technologist will support the Android Brand and Google Play Creative team by building the tools, workflows, demos, and prototypes that help creative ideas get stronger and move faster. This role has two connected parts.

First, you will help improve the team’s creative process by building internal tools and AI-enabled workflows for briefing, ideation, prototyping, review, production, localization, and scale. Second, you will help turn Google product capabilities into campaign ideas, product demos, prototypes, and consumer-facing stories.

You will work closely with creative leads, brand marketers, designers, writers, PMMs, producers, product managers, engineers, and external partners to make ideas tangible. The strongest candidate will bring technical fluency, creative judgment, product accuracy, and a builder’s mindset.

What we are looking for We are seeing a Creative Technologist who is excited by emerging technology and can help the Android Brand and Google Play Creative team move faster, think sharper, and make more original work by turning emerging technology into useful tools, demos, prototypes, and creative workflows.

This role sits between creative, product, and technology. You will help articulate campaign ideas, translate product capabilities into clear consumer stories, and make those ideas tangible. The right candidate is part creative thinker, part technical maker, part systems builder, and part AI craftsperson.

You should be able to move quickly across AI tools, Figma, lightweight code, APIs, no-code/low-code platforms, and production tools to help teams see what is possible and make stronger creative decisions. Originally posted on Himalayas

About WPP Production
We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.
About WPP
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com .
A Hybrid working model
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
What does a Senior Creative Technologist do at WPP Production?

A Senior Creative Technologist is a confident technical and creative leader who delivers exceptional work and elevates the team around them with +10 years of experience. The candidate should have strong understanding of the creative and production industry, ultimately worked within a creative agency (or in-house agency) or a production company for a vast majority of their career.
They can shape ideas, briefs and expand on concepts, not only execute them.
They don’t just build prototypes; they think about how things can scale.
They don’t just solve problems; they spot them early and think about mitigating risk.
They are comfortable working with clients and have strong presentation skills.
The Senior CT plays a supporting leadership role across strategic and creative delivery, mentoring and standards. Senior CTs own workstreams, line manage junior team members and help ensure that what we ship is technically robust, creatively ambitious and compliant with corporate and client expectations.

The Senior CT has strong technical capabilities to guide teams about the suitable models they should work with for each project and provide technical support for the different models, programs and tools.

· Line manages Creative Technologists

· Set clear expectations and support personal development plans

· Run regular, 1:1 with honest feedback loops

· Actively mentor less confident team members, creating space for them to grow

· Confidently propose and justify technical approaches in response to briefs

· Take responsibility for ensuring creative and technical output meets corporate and client standards

· Work closely with Producers/PMs to scope realistically and protect quality

· Turn ideas into meaningful prototypes that support internal new business

· Balance experimentation with integrated production discipline

· Anticipate technical risks and resolve issues early

· Develop scalable workflows across AI, real-time and other emerging tech

· Encourage ownership and pride in output

· Share knowledge openly and raise the overall capability of the team

· Escalate when something doesn’t match the brief or standards

· Be the bridge between Creative, Strategy, Production and Tech

· Clearly explain complex technical approaches to non-technical audiences

· Represent the Creative Technology team confidently in client settings

· Provide transparent updates on progress, blockers and risks

· Give constructive, solution-focused feedback

· Proactively identify opportunities to prototype new ideas or tools

· Contribute to group R&D initiatives

· Stay curious about emerging tech and share insights with the team

· Strong capability across multiple areas such as: Unreal (Blueprints, UEFN, Verse), creative coding, generative AI workflows, AR/VR, 3D, interaction design, world building, automation pipelines etc.

· Proven ability to deliver high-quality technical work with minimal oversight

· Experience mentoring or line managing junior team members

· Strong troubleshooting skills across technical/creative pipelines

· Confident communicator both internally and with clients.

· Comfortable working in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments

· High standards and a strong sense of accountability

· Great collaborator and team player that is used to working with multiple stakeholders co-owning a project

· Commercial awareness and understanding of production realities

At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry.

You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity.

With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.
Inclusion and Impact
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

This position sits in our Marketing & Technology service based in London. We combine data, technology, creative content, and paid media to crack brands’ business problems & drive revenue through a variety of digital marketing solutions like ad campaigns, augmented reality, and chatbots. Our clients include PepsiCo, Just Eat Takeaway, Twitch, TikTok, and L’Oréal.
Own DEPT®'s emerging creative technology practice across EMEA — the experimentation engine that discovers what's next in AI-enabled creative and content production. Lead its direction, win and shape the work, and embed the capability in our most strategic client relationships, while owning the R&D agenda and the products that turn experimentation into repeatable, revenue-generating practice.
The role sits at the intersection of creative technology, commercial growth, and capability building. It moves fluidly between the client and pitch rooms and the strategic work of the R&D agenda, product thinking, and the future direction of AI-enabled creative.

Practice leadership and commercial growth
Lead the emerging AI creative practice across the region. Win and shape new business; pitches, scoping, propositions, and commercial models. Convert demand into a defined, repeatable, profitable offer.
Senior client partnership
Named accountability on flagship accounts or projects. Shape clients' innovation pilots and Creative AI roadmaps upstream as a trusted advisor. Lead the delivery of emerging creative-technology engagements directly with clients - experimentation applied to real briefs - and provide oversight and escalation across the wider portfolio.
AI capability and R&D roadmap
Own the development of the R&D agenda for emerging creative technology in collaboration with peers across the business.
Maintain a deep working understanding of the field - the models, techniques, and principles beneath the tools - so the practice stays ahead of the market.
Balance two tracks: proven production tools and trusted workflows that identify new production and revenue streams, and an experimentation track that brings emerging models and techniques into the offer ahead of the market.
Own the path by which the experiments become standard. Push the agency's wider creative-technology literacy and capability forward, working with markets to embed it in delivery and design teams.
Product and innovation
Own the orchestration and product thinking that connects creative production end-to-end - the layer between idea, production, versioning, scale, and optimisation, including quality control at volume and the feedback loops that improve output over time.
Turn what's proven in experimentation into repeatable product and standard practice, and identify where the next commercial offerings sit.
Maintain working awareness of proprietary tooling so the practice stays complementary to it.
Connect to the DEPT® Ecosystem
Work in close collaboration with the Deptify (proprietary orchestration product) and Studio teams — both established core solutions. Stay close to what they're building so the edge and core stay aligned, duplication is avoided, and proven work hands cleanly from experimentation into their remit. Support integrations and work flexibly alongside them on projects where the handoff isn't yet defined, driving the offer forward together.

10+ years across creative agency, content production, or applied creative technology, with meaningful time at senior practitioner and practice-leadership level
Track record of winning and growing creative technology / AI work commercially
Hands-on credibility across copy, image, video, and audio generation. You hold the room with clients on tools, approaches, and trade-offs
Experience helping teams and markets adopt new creative-technology tools and ways of working
Strong executive presence and senior client relationships

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work.

You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact.

We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
This position requires a hybrid work schedule with regular in-person attendance at our Menlo Park office.
We are seeking a Creative Technologist, Brand AI to help redefine how artificial intelligence supports brand and creative work at Snowflake across design, content, video, customer marketing and web.
You are a multidisciplinary creative technologist who combines strong creative judgment, systems thinking, and hands-on technical ability. You understand how designers, writers, strategists, producers, and marketers work, and you can translate emerging AI capabilities into practical tools that improve work quality, consistency, and speed.
Equal parts builder, strategist, and facilitator, you will partner across Brand Marketing to experiment rapidly, build custom solutions, and help teams incorporate AI into their daily workflows. This role sits at the intersection of creative technology, brand systems, AI innovation, and workflow design, reporting to the Director of Brand Strategy and AI Innovation.

Explore and Prototype New Creative Possibilities
Partner with designers, writers, producers, strategists, and marketers to identify where AI can meaningfully improve creative quality, consistency, speed, or scale.
Turn emerging AI capabilities into tangible prototypes, tools, and experiences that creative teams can evaluate and use.
Rapidly experiment with generative AI across visual design, writing, web, motion, video, brand management, and content-production workflows.
Bring a strong creative and strategic point of view to where AI adds genuine value and where human craft, judgment, and originality should remain central.
Create demonstrations and proof-of-concept experiences that help teams understand what new technologies make possible.
Build Useful Tools and Connected Workflows
Design and build a growing collection of AI-enabled tools, utilities, templates, and workflows that address real needs across the Brand Marketing organization.
Connect creative platforms, content systems, AI models, and internal data using the right combination of prototyping tools, APIs, automation platforms, low-code solutions, and custom code.
Design solutions around the complete creative workflow, not just an isolated task, accounting for the people, systems, inputs, approvals, and downstream uses involved.
Take promising prototypes from concept to reliable internal adoption, partnering with engineering, IT, security, legal, and platform teams when solutions require production-grade support.
Iterate based on feedback, observed usage, creative quality, and measurable improvements to the team’s work.
Partner With and Enable Creative Teams
Serve as a hands-on creative technology partner across Brand Marketing, developing a deep understanding of how each team works and where shared solutions could have broader value.
Facilitate workshops, working sessions, demonstrations, and onboarding that help teams confidently incorporate AI into their creative practices.
Create accessible resources such as playbooks, examples, templates, prompt patterns, and workflow documentation.
Translate technical concepts into language that creative and marketing teams can understand and act on.
Build trust and adoption by involving end users throughout the discovery, prototyping, and iteration process.
Evolve Brand Systems for an AI-Enabled World
Help define how Snowflake’s voice, visual identity, design principles, and brand standards should be represented in AI-enabled tools and workflows.
Develop practical methods for evaluating the quality, originality, consistency, and brand alignment of AI-assisted work.
Establish reusable patterns, guidance, and guardrails that help teams experiment responsibly without limiting creative exploration.
Partner with brand, legal, privacy, security, and responsible-AI stakeholders to address risk and appropriate use.
Identify gaps, patterns, and opportunities across teams, and provide leadership with a clear view of what is working and where to invest next.
Stay Connected to the Creative Technology Landscape
Evaluate emerging models, platforms, interfaces, and creative tools for their relevance to brand and marketing work.
Maintain an active practice of experimentation and prototyping rather than relying only on vendor demonstrations or industry trends.
Share useful discoveries with the broader organization and help Snowflake develop an informed perspective on the future of AI-enabled creative work.

7+ years of experience in creative technology, design technology, digital experience, creative innovation, prototyping, design systems, or a related multidisciplinary field.
A portfolio or case studies demonstrating how you have used technology to solve creative, brand, design, content, or marketing problems.
Demonstrated experience applying generative AI to real creative or marketing workflows. We care more about the usefulness, quality, and adoption of your work than a specific number of years with any particular model or platform.
Strong creative and design foundations, including an understanding of brand systems, visual and verbal identity, user experience, creative production, and the intent behind creative decisions.
Hands-on ability to make ideas tangible through prototypes, interactive experiences, workflow automation, or lightweight internal tools.
Comfort working with AI models, prompting techniques, APIs, structured data, and prototyping or automation platforms. You do not need to be a traditional software engineer, but you should be able to independently build and test functional ideas.
Experience connecting tools and systems through low-code platforms, custom scripting, APIs, or similar methods.
A systems-oriented approach: you consider the broader workflow, stakeholders, governance requirements, and long-term usability of what you create.
Strong communication and facilitation skills across creative, marketing, technical, and executive audiences.
The ability to navigate ambiguity, identify the most valuable problems to solve, and move quickly from exploration to a working solution.
A collaborative, low-ego approach and genuine enthusiasm for helping other people develop new capabilities.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in Design, Creative Technology, Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science, Digital Media, or a related field.

About Truelogic
At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.
Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.
By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.
Our Client
A global digital transformation organization that helps leading enterprises reimagine how they create, manage, and deliver customer experiences by combining technology, creativity, AI, and engineering. Through multidisciplinary teams and hands-on execution, we partner with organizations to modernize workflows, scale content operations, accelerate innovation, and build solutions that drive measurable business impact.

We are seeking a Creative Technologist to join our team at the intersection of creative strategy, brand execution, and emerging AI technology.
This is a highly hands-on, enterprise-level, and client-facing role operating in an embedded lab environment alongside creative, brand, studio, and vendor teams. The Creative Technologist will lead the implementation, configuration, testing, and governance of AI-powered creative workflows and automation.
The role requires someone who can translate complex business and creative requirements into scalable, testable GenAI workflows , configure AI agents and pipelines, and work directly with senior stakeholders to drive adoption and continuous improvement.

Translate creative and business team requests into scoped, testable GenAI workflow builds with clearly defined requirements and success criteria.
Build, configure, test, and maintain GenAI workflows, feeds, agents, and automation pipelines for assigned categories and use cases.
Configure prompts, model settings, workflow logic, and agent behaviors across multiple GenAI models.
Design and maintain node-based workflows using visual logic builders and similar technologies.
Document workflow builds, configurations, testing results, and learnings.
Contribute to shared playbooks, documentation, and knowledge transfer across creative technology teams.
Plan and execute structured testing across new categories and use cases against defined test plans, acceptance criteria, and KPIs.
Build and maintain design system components, templates, and modular creative assets within GenAI workflows.
Configure quality-control, validation, and scoring mechanisms for generated outputs in alignment with established governance standards.
Monitor and optimize workflow efficiency, including model usage, credit/token consumption, output quality, and production performance.
Facilitate discovery sessions and stakeholder alignment workshops to understand business needs and translate them into technical workflow requirements.
Partner closely with creative, marketing, brand, studio, and technology stakeholders throughout the workflow lifecycle.
Identify opportunities to improve automation, scalability, consistency, and creative production efficiency.

Hands-on experience building, configuring, or operating enterprise GenAI workflows, pipelines, agents, or automation systems .
Hands-on experience with node-based, graph-based workflow editors, or visual logic builders , such as ComfyUI, n8n, Figma Weave, or similar tools.
Experience configuring GenAI prompts, workflows, agents, and model selection across multiple GenAI models.
Proven ability to translate business and creative requirements into structured, testable workflows with defined success criteria.
Experience evaluating and optimizing AI-generated outputs against defined quality standards, acceptance criteria, or KPIs.
Proven experience operating in a client-facing or senior stakeholder-facing role within an enterprise, corporate environment, agency, or consultancy.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, including experience facilitating discovery sessions, requirements gathering, and stakeholder alignment workshops.
Strong understanding of the creative and marketing production lifecycle , including creative briefs, asset production, review and approval processes, brand asset management, modular design systems, and content component production.
Ability to collaborate effectively with creative, marketing, brand, studio, production, and technology teams.
Experience working with AI in an enterprise or professional environment ; candidates whose AI experience is strictly limited to personal, side-project, academic, or hobbyist use will not be considered.
Based in Latin America (LATAM) with availability to work remotely.
Advanced English proficiency , with strong verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work full-time hours aligned with US Central Time (CT) .

Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud , particularly Photoshop.
Experience with Figma or similar design and prototyping tools.
Experience with enterprise work management and creative operations platforms such as Adobe Workfront .
Exposure to 3D asset pipelines, spatial design, CGI, or other emerging creative technologies that interface with GenAI workflows.
Familiarity with data visualization, analytics dashboards, or performance tracking systems.
Experience measuring workflow efficiency, credit/token consumption, output acceptance, or other AI production KPIs.
Previous experience with Pencil.ai or similar AI-powered creative automation platforms.

100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.
Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.
Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.
Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

We build production AI systems for enterprises. We are an AI-first systems integrator and a Select-tier partner in Anthropic's Claude Partner Network, among the first integrators selected. The work is good. Most people have never heard of it.
That is the job.
We are looking for one person who can tell the story of what we build and build things themselves. Not a marketer who uses AI tools. Not an engineer who writes copy. Someone who moves between the two without noticing the border.

We build production AI systems for enterprises. Financial services, healthcare companies, PE-backed operators. We are a Select-tier partner in Anthropic's Claude Partner Network, among the first integrators selected.
Every one of those systems has two stories. What we built, and why it changed the economics of the business that bought it. Most technical marketing tells the first and bores the buyer.
We want one person who can tell both, and build things themselves. Not a marketer who uses AI tools. Not an engineer who writes copy. Someone who moves between the two without noticing the border.

Tell both halves of the story. Sit close to the teams shipping these systems, understand what was actually hard, and translate it into video, writing, and demos that travel. Then go a level up: what the system changed for the operator, what it cost, what it replaced, why the CFO signed. Shape how Provectus is positioned.

Not just the case studies but the argument above them. What we stand for, which problems we claim, where we say no. You will have a real hand in that, not a style guide to follow.
Build the tools that make the marketing work. A scraper that watches what our market is saying. An agent that drafts case studies from delivery artifacts. A microsite for a launch. A dashboard showing which stories moved pipeline. You write the code. You do not file a ticket and wait. Own channels outright. Write, publish, and measure across LinkedIn, YouTube, X, and whatever channel matters six months from now that does not matter today.
Run experiments and kill the ones that lose. Real budget, real autonomy, in exchange for showing your numbers.

You have shipped things people used. A side project, a channel with an audience, a tool, a launch. We care more about what you made than where you worked. You write well, and you have a point of view. You can hold attention for 90 seconds on video and 900 words on a page. You are curious about how companies make money.

You can read a business case and find the part that actually matters. You can sit with a CFO or a PE operator and not reach for features. You code. Python or TypeScript, comfortably. You use Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent every day and you have opinions about them. You have built something agentic that does actual work.

You are interested in AI for real. You read the papers, or the people who read the papers, and you have changed your mind about something in the last six months. You are anywhere from your first job to your tenth year. Three levels, one bar: what have you made.

If you are early, show us an internship where the bar was high and a portfolio with range. If you are senior, tell us what you built with your own hands in the last 90 days. You are in New York or San Francisco, or you will be.

Direct access to the people building the systems and the executives selling them. Small team, no layers between you and the work.
A budget for tools, models, and experiments, with no approval chain under a threshold.
Promotion tied to output, not tenure.
401(k) profit sharing plan after probation period
Unlimited PTO policy
Medical, Visual and Dental insurance

What Does a Creative Technologist Do at WPP Production?
A Creative Technologist at WPP Production operates at the intersection of creativity, technology, and generative AI to design and deliver AI-powered creative solutions at scale. The role collaborates with creative, production, technology, and strategy teams to develop intelligent workflows that combine multimodal AI, automation, and human creativity to produce high-quality marketing content across digital channels.

Collaborate with creative, strategy, production, and technology teams to design AI-powered creative solutions for marketing campaigns.
Translate creative concepts into structured prompt frameworks and multimodal content generation strategies.
Develop and optimize workflows using generative AI tools for image, video, text, and audio content creation.
Partner with technical teams to build, test, and improve AI-driven production pipelines and automation workflows.
Prototype and evaluate emerging AI tools, models, and technologies to enhance creative production capabilities.

Support the development of reusable prompt libraries, templates, workflows, and best practices for scalable content production.
Work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate AI capabilities into existing creative and production processes.
Present AI-powered creative solutions, demonstrations, and recommendations to internal stakeholders and clients.
Identify opportunities to improve production efficiency through automation, workflow optimization, and AI innovation.
Stay up to date with advancements in Generative AI, multimodal models, creative technologies, and industry trends.
